COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Web Development Fundamentals.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Binary Arithmetic Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Binary Arithmetic Operations.

5. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

9. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.

10. When learning Structured Query Language, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Structured Query Language.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Structured Query Language.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

13. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

14. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. When learning Logic Gates, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
